restrictions.text: BLM: overnight camping permits required year-round (Recreation.gov 74466); day use without permit.
BLM: Gunnison Gorge Wilderness permit required ($3 day use, $10/$15 per person for one/two nights); maximum stay two nights/three days; interagency passes not valid.
BLM: boats and gear carried ~1 mile down the Chukar Trail; no carts or wheeled devices in the wilderness; access road often requires 4WD.
BLM DENCA: overnight boaters self-issue a free camping permit.
restrictions.sourceName: BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide

restrictions.text: BLM: Bridgeport is small craft only via the trail under the railroad bridge; walking over the tracks is trespass.
restrictions.sourceName: BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide

restrictions.text: NPS: a river permit is required for all river trips in Dinosaur NM (Recreation.gov 250014). 2027 season per Recreation.gov: lottery applications Dec 1 – Jan 31, results Feb 12, 2027, confirm by Mar 1; low-use and unclaimed permits from Mar 6, 2027; Yampa high-use season May 10 – Jul 10, 2027. Fees: $15 non-refundable application, $185 recreation fee. Normal high-use Yampa trip 5 days/4 nights (NPS 2025 guide).
restrictions.sourceName: Recreation.gov permit content API, Dinosaur NM river permit 250014

restrictions.text: BLM guide: hazardous bridges at RM 29.6 above Two Bridges when flows exceed 5,500 cfs.

restrictions.text: Dolores permit text conflict: BLM map/guide text vs BLM web page (free Recreation.gov permit). Not resolved; river held in drafts.

NPS Dinosaur NM: 'A permit is required to boat into the monument from above Gates of Lodore or Deerlodge' and 'One play permit per day will be issued for groups who wish to take out at Lodore or Deerlodge. To avoid congestion at the take-out, it is recommended to arrive after 2 pm.' A day float from West Cross Mountain that takes out at Deerlodge therefore needs this NPS one-day play permit (FAQ: no fee; issued at the Quarry Visitor Center or by the River Office; 2025 guide: also on-site rangers/volunteer camp hosts, no advance reservation). Continuing below Deerlodge needs a Yampa river permit (Recreation.gov 250014) and boater check-in at Deerlodge. CPW: 'Boaters who pass Deerlodge Park must have a permit'. Sources differ on the issuer (River Permit Office vs Quarry Visitor Center/rangers); confirm with NPS when planning.
restrictions.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26)

restrictions.text: NPS: play permits are required for boating upstream of the Gates of Lodore or Deerlodge Park boat ramps and for downstream travel from the Split Mountain Boat Ramp; groups launching above Deerlodge must stop at Deerlodge for boater check-in before continuing on a permitted trip.
restrictions.sourceName: NPS Dinosaur NM 'Boating and Rafting' page (re-fetched 2026-10-26)

restrictions.text: CPW AHRA: a Colorado State Parks daily or annual pass is required at AHRA fee sites (Stone Bridge and Rincon are fee sites).
CPW AHRA safety map: Salida Low Head Dam at mile 59 — scout and run the boat chute on river left.
CPW AHRA safety map: Stone Bridge (mile 52.3, CR 191) may require a portage above 4,000 cfs at the Nathrop gauge; portage river right.
CPW AHRA safety map: the Salida Whitewater Park begins at mile 61.5 — expect hanging slalom gates and congestion around the play hole at the Salida boat ramp.
